title: In-scope request with nothing to grade — agent asks for input

response.response:
CheckMate grades scanned Technion Calculus 1 (Hedva 1) exam booklets. No scan is attached and no bundled booklet was named, so there is nothing to grade.

To grade a booklet: upload the scanned exam (multipart `file` on /api/execute, or the upload box in the UI), or name one of the bundled sample booklets in your prompt:
  - "sample-1" — Sample booklet 1 — 104041 2024 Winter Moed A (18-page scan, human-graded 90/100)
  - "sample-2" — Sample booklet 2 — 104041 2024 Winter Moed A, second student (18-page scan, human-graded 93/100)

Example: {"prompt": "Grade sample booklet 1"}

(If you were asking about something other than grading a Calculus 1 exam, that is outside CheckMate's scope.)

prompt.System_prompt: Decide whether this grading request carries anything to grade: an attached scan or a named sample booklet.

response.reason: No scan attached and no sample booklet named.
